segments.narration: Here are 144 dots arranged in a 12 by 12 grid. Without counting one by one, how many are there?
Split it into friendly pieces: ten columns of 12 give us 120, and the last two columns of 12 give us 24.
Now add those two friendly pieces together — 120 plus 24 — and the answer lands: 12 times 12 is 144.
